NLRB_CASES.label: NLRB case records via LaborData structured mirror
NLRB_CASES.semantic_boundary: A charge/petition/case filing is a proceeding record, not a finding that an employer violated law.

OSHA_ENFORCEMENT.label: OSHA enforcement records via LaborData structured mirror
OSHA_ENFORCEMENT.source_of_record: U.S. Department of Labor / OSHA Enforcement Data Catalog
OSHA_ENFORCEMENT.semantic_boundary: An inspection or citation applies to the recorded establishment/event and must not be generalized to the whole company.

DOL_WHD.label: U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division compliance actions via LaborData structured mirror
DOL_WHD.source_of_record: U.S. Department of Labor / Wage and Hour Division
DOL_WHD.semantic_boundary: WHD compliance actions are case-specific agency enforcement findings; they must not be generalized to every facility, period, or practice of the company.

USA_SPENDING.label: USAspending.gov federal awards
USA_SPENDING.source_of_record: U.S. Department of the Treasury / USAspending.gov
USA_SPENDING.semantic_boundary: Federal award records prove a specific public award relationship; they do not describe the company complete customer, supplier, or commercial network.

FMCS_F7.label: FMCS Collective Bargaining Notice (F-7) data via LaborData
FMCS_F7.semantic_boundary: An F-7 notice documents a collective-bargaining notice/relationship and affected unit; it is not evidence of a labor-law violation.

NLRB_VOLUNTARY_RECOGNITION.label: NLRB voluntary-recognition notices via LaborData
NLRB_VOLUNTARY_RECOGNITION.semantic_boundary: A voluntary-recognition notice records a representation event; it does not imply wrongdoing.

FMCS_WORK_STOPPAGES.label: FMCS work stoppages via LaborData
FMCS_WORK_STOPPAGES.semantic_boundary: A work stoppage record documents an event; causes and responsibility require separate evidence.

OLMS_LM20.label: OLMS employer/consultant disclosure reports via LaborData LM-20/LM-21 records
OLMS_LM20.source_of_record: U.S. Department of Labor / Office of Labor-Management Standards
OLMS_LM20.semantic_boundary: A filed LM report documents a statutory disclosure/arrangement; scope depends on the form and report and must not be paraphrased as an unfair-labor-practice finding.

OPENCORPORATES.label: OpenCorporates
OPENCORPORATES.note: Disabled by default because API terms/share-alike requirements must be reviewed against this project license.

OPEN_SUPPLY_HUB.label: Open Supply Hub
OPEN_SUPPLY_HUB.note: A facility/contributor match is a supply-chain candidate until provenance and relationship scope are reviewed.
